_comment: Thresholds per Analysis_Phase0_TCB_Jan26.md section 7.1. PRD section 6.2 requires these be admin-configurable, not hard-coded.
_operating_point: Selected from the s7 frontier sweep. 'wide' strictly dominates 'balanced' and 'tight' (same review volume, higher trap catch). 'widest' is rejected: R9 precision falls to 0.38 and action agreement collapses to 62%. autoclear_guard cuts value wrongly auto-cleared from 12.1% to 3.1% for +12pp review volume.
_triage: Advisory triage gates. Guarded bulk preselection stays off until the recorded backtest clears the precision bar.
_similarity: Advisory KNN peer-evidence layer. Never alters Min/ROP/Max or lowers a risk level.
_criticality: PRD section 5.3 machine_criticality_config. Engineer-owned; keyed on machine_type, NOT module (APPJ machine types appear inside TCB module rows). Empty until engineers populate it.
_riskfactors: Rule 9 fires when recom=0 AND any of these input-only risk factors hold.
